questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

All lemons are plums.

All plums are dates.

Some dates are mangoes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some lemons are mangoes.

II. Some mangoes are plums.

III. All lemons are dates.

IV. Some mangoes are dates.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Both conclusions III and IV follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and IV follow

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All lemons are plums.

All plums are dates.

Some dates are mangoes.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96335f62751e05f1217256667d4f8c796e1e565f6517840186b58b5a2cef6b56.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some lemons are mangoes → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. Some mangoes are plums → False (It is possible but not definite)

III. All lemons are dates → True (because all lemons are plums and all plums are dates so definitely all lemons are also dates)

IV. Some mangoes are dates → True (because some dates are mangoes so, definitely some mangoes are also dates)

Hence, “**Both conclusions III and IV follow”****.**

Given:

 
 

 
 
45

 
 
 
9

122

12

 
 
 

 
 
116

 
 
 
6

 
 
 
?

 
 
 

 

Here the pattern followed in **each row** is:

**{(2ⁿd number)² + (3rd number)² } ÷ 2 = 1st number**

Row 1: 45, 9, 3

{(2ⁿd number)² + (3rd number)² } ÷ 2

= (9² + 3²) ÷ 2

= (81 + 9) ÷ 2

= 90 ÷ 2

= 45 = 1st number

Row 2: 122, 10, 12

{(2ⁿd number)² + (3rd number)² } ÷ 2

= (10² + 12²) ÷ 2

= (100 + 144) ÷ 2

= 244 ÷ 2

= 122 = 1st number

Similarly,

**Row 3: 116, 6, ?**

**{(2ⁿd number)² + (3rd number)² } ÷ 2 = 116**

**= (6² + ?²) ÷ 2 = 116**

**= (36 + ?²) = 232**

**= ?² = 232 - 36 = 196**

**= ? = 14 = 1st number**

**Hence, “14” is correct answer.**

questions.question: The income of three playback singers Aswath, Sunita and Ramdin are in the ratio of 12 ∶ 9 ∶ 7 and their expenditures are in the ratio 15 ∶ 9 ∶ 8. If Aswath saves 25% of his income, what is the ratio of the savings of Aswath, Sunita and Ramdin?
questions.solution:
Income → Aswath : Sunita : Ramdin → 12x : 9x : 7x

Expenditures → Aswath : Sunita : Ramdin → 15y : 9y : 8y

**Savings = Income - Expenditures**

Aswath : Sunita : Ramdin → 12x - 15y : 9x - 9y : 7x - 8y

Given:

Aswath saves 25% of his income for future investments

12x - 15y = 25% of 12x

=> 12x - 15y = 3x

=> 9x = 15y

=> x / y = 15 / 9

So, x = 15; y = 9

Put the value of x and y saving of Aswath, Sunita and Ramdin.

=> 12x -15y : 9x - 9y : 7x - 8y

=> (12 × 15 - 15 × 9) : (9 × 15 – 9 × 9) : (7 × 15 - 8 × 9)

=> (180 - 135) : (135 - 81) : (105 - 72)

=> 45 : 54 : 33

Divided by 3,

=> 15 : 18 : 11

Hence, ‘15 : 18 : 11’ is the ratio of the savings of Aswath, Sunita and Ramdin.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'LABOUR' is coded as '279', and 'EXHALE' is coded as '321'. How will 'CAUTIOUS' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
**The table is alphabets place value:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is: 

**Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters × Total number of vowels in word = number.**

**LABOUR** **→** Total number of **vowels** (A, O, U) in the word is 3. 

Opposite alphabets of a given word are

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80ee08ee8802394ed7ce7e57984799c0c0261348d343d78b36b2f1d50d226c81.png] 

=> Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters × Total number of **vowels** in word = number

=> (15 +26 + 25 + 12 + 6 + 9) × 3 = 93 × 3 = 279

And,

**EXHALE** **→** Total number of **vowels** (E, A, E) in the word is 3. 

Opposite alphabets of given word is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/258f3300d278e5a4a07483d2c3528d6fe6a6e197a64acb602f3296a645d2c762.png] 

=> Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters × Total number of **vowels** in word = number

=> (22 + 3 + 19 + 26 + 15 + 22) × 3 = 107 × 3 = 321

Similarly,

**CAUTIOUS** **→** **Total number of ****vowels**** (A, U, I, O, U) in the word is 5. **

**Opposite alphabets of given word is**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4d83ff14bd6b27300e992a4853e4b5f449c4bf6ef7d927dcebae1ff781a87c5.png] 

**=> Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters × Total number of ****vowels**** in word = number**

**=> (24 + 26 + 6 + 7 + 18 + 12 + 6 + 8) × 5 = 107 × 5 = 535**

Hence, **CAUTIOUS** will be written as** “535”.**
